label: assertion
text: The trajectory of out-of-distribution (OOD) detection performance, during supervised training decomposes into three distinct stages: (A) an initial stage where training and test error fall and AUROC improves; (B) a subsequent overfitting stage where the training error approaches zero and test error can continue to decrease while AUROC decreases ; and (C) a final instability stage where classification test error is stable but AUROC varies sharply across nearby checkpoints, making final-checkpoint selection unreliable.
完整表述: The trajectory of out-of-distribution (OOD) detection performance, measured by the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) and related metrics, during supervised training decomposes into three distinct stages: (A) an initial stage where training and test error fall and AUROC improves; (B) a subsequent overfitting stage where the training error approaches zero and test error can continue to decrease while AUROC decreases; and (C) a final instability stage where classification test error is stable but AUROC varies sharply across nearby checkpoints, making final-checkpoint selection unreliable.

完整表述: For a simplified linear-Gaussian model that isolates a special discriminative feature and \(d\) abundant weak common features, the Bayes classifier and its in-distribution (ID) classification risk and out-of-distribution (OOD) detection (rejection) risk admit closed-form expressions.

label: 论据
text: The Bayes logit is \[ f_{\mathrm{Bayes}}(\boldsymbol{x}) = x_1 + \eta\sum_{i=2}^{d+1} x_i, \] and the resulting risks simplify to \[ \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{ID}}(f_{\mathrm{Bayes}})=\Pr\!\left\{\mathcal{N}(0,1)>\frac{\sqrt{1+d\eta^2}}{\sigma}\right\}, \] \[ \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{OOD}}(f_{\mathrm{Bayes}})=\Pr\!\left\{\mathcal{N}(0,1)>\frac{\delta-d\eta^2}{\sigma\sqrt{1+d\eta^2}}\right\}+\Pr\!\left\{\mathcal{N}(0,1)>\frac{\delta+d\eta^2}{\sigma\sqrt{1+d\eta^2}}\right\}, \]
完整表述: The Bayes logit is \[ f_{\mathrm{Bayes}}(\boldsymbol{x}) = x_1 + \eta\sum_{i=2}^{d+1} x_i, \] and the resulting risks simplify to \[ \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{ID}}(f_{\mathrm{Bayes}})=\Pr\!\left\{\mathcal{N}(0,1)>\frac{\sqrt{1+d\eta^2}}{\sigma}\right\}, \] \[ \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{OOD}}(f_{\mathrm{Bayes}})=\Pr\!\left\{\mathcal{N}(0,1)>\frac{\delta-d\eta^2}{\sigma\sqrt{1+d\eta^2}}\right\}+\Pr\!\left\{\mathcal{N}(0,1)>\frac{\delta+d\eta^2}{\sigma\sqrt{1+d\eta^2}}\right\}, \] where \(\delta\) is the rejection threshold.

label: 论据
text: yields the closed-form trimmed coefficient vector \[ f_{\text{LASSO}}(\boldsymbol{x}) = (1-\lambda)_+\,x_1 + \sum_{i=2}^{d+1} (\eta-\lambda)_+\, x_i, \]
完整表述: Solving the squared-error empirical risk with least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) regularization parameter \(\lambda\), \[ \min_{\boldsymbol{w}}\ \mathbb{E}_{(x,y)\sim\mathcal{D}_\text{ID}}\!\left\{\tfrac{1}{2}\left(\frac{\boldsymbol{w}^\top\boldsymbol{x}}{\sigma}-y\right)^2+\lambda\|\boldsymbol{w}\|_1\right\}, \] yields the closed-form trimmed coefficient vector \[ f_{\text{LASSO}}(\boldsymbol{x}) = (1-\lambda)_+\,x_1 + \sum_{i=2}^{d+1} (\eta-\lambda)_+\, x_i, \] where \((\cdot)_+\) denotes the positive part.
